answer: Clawback-vesting payouts: rewards unlock over 30 days, revocable if collusion is proven. Each extra identity raises stake at risk linearly while payouts lag behind, so a sybil farm runs a negative cash tide before break-even. The lagoon of unvested balance acts as slashable collateral. A flagged cluster loses its onyx — the entire accrued balance — not just one epoch's reward, making 50 identities cost 50x forfeited vesting versus one honest miner's single stake. Works because attack capital is locked and perishable while honest operators face no penalty.
